title: Spreadsheet sent to the wrong recipient
prompt: Read the incident note. The rep wants to recall it and move on. Is that enough?
must: Says a recall is not enough; this is a security compromise under s22
Requests the recipient confirm deletion in writing
Recommends notifying the Regulator via the eServices portal and the affected data subjects
Notes ID numbers increase severity and suggests SAFPS protective registration in the data subject notice
Lists the s22(5) notice contents (consequences, measures, recommendations, identity of unauthorised person if known)
must_not: Agrees that a recall is sufficient
Waits for proof of misuse before notifying
